recomputed_numbers.hand_identity: Checker hand proof (new): for a 60-degree wedge of the 3-coloured triangular lattice with apex on a colour-0 site and Gaussian weights centred on the apex, W_0 - W_1 = 1/3 exactly up to terms exp(-2 pi^2 R^2/9). Six rotated wedges tile the plane; the 60-degree rotation maps colour c to -c; the apex is counted six times and each ray twice; a 1D Poisson sum on the rays gives rho_0 - rho_1 = -3; so W_0 - W_1 = (5 - 3)/6 = 1/3, and W_1 = W_2 by the wedge mirror. Since dq sums to 0 over the three colours on each sublayer, the corner window equals Delta_0/3 = dQ/3. The 3 in the denominator is the number of colour classes of the supplied pattern.
